P4's failure mode is over-answering after the walk-down stops changing the plan (Watch-fors, line 207) with the paired trainer move at Push-back moves line 228 ('what would the next answer still change in execution?'), which cleanly recovers a facilitator who did not design the exercise and matches the accept-notes at lines 128/130/134.
